_comment: Convenience autocomplete list for the 'Pull a new model' action on the LLM Providers admin screen. Purely data — admins may add/remove/reorder entries freely, and the pull action (POST /llm-providers/{id}/pull-model) works for ANY model name typed in, whether or not it appears here, since Ollama has no API to browse its full model library. The first entry is also what install.sh pulls by default for a fresh Ollama setup (see db/bootstrap_llm_providers.py).
